All fixes live — adapter v0.7.1 loaded with `supportsLocalAgentJwt: true`, fresh module graph from the r9 path (no server restart needed).

## What was broken and what I fixed

**1. "You updated this task" ghost interactions (the big one)**
The plugin's `createServerAdapter()` never declared `supportsLocalAgentJwt`, so Paperclip never gave it a per-run agent JWT. Every control-plane call the Groq agents made (status changes to blocked, comments, assignments) went out **unauthenticated** and the server attributed them to the local board user — you. You weren't marking tasks blocked; the agents were, under your name. Fixed: flag added in `dist/index.js`, and the tool layer already forwards `ctx.authToken` as a Bearer header, so actions are now attributed to the agent that did them.

**2. Eager self-blocking (GLI-237 pattern)**
The Coder blocked "Improved readme" because it "couldn't retrieve details" — the tool surface had no way to read an issue's comment thread. Added a `paperclip_get_comments` tool, plus protocol rules: read the thread before claiming missing info, ask via comment + `in_review` instead of `blocked`, reserve `blocked` for a named owner who must act.

**3. Broken handoffs**
Sub-tasks were being created without an assignee (e.g. GLI-238 sitting in `todo` assigned to "user"), so no agent ever picked them up. Protocol now requires `assigneeAgentId` on every delegated `paperclip_create_issue`, with ids from `paperclip_list_agents`.

**4. False "done" (GLI-235 pattern)**
CTO marked the deletion task done while explicitly admitting it did nothing. Added a hard rule: never set `done` unless tool results verify the work happened — use `in_review`/`blocked` otherwise.

All of this is on top of the earlier fixes (JSON-only tool protocol, dedup parser, disposition nudges, thinking-stream logging), which are now actually live too — turns out the earlier in-place dist edits were trapped behind Node's ESM module cache; the r9 reinstall flushed them.

Leftover state I did **not** touch: GLI-235/234 falsely `done`, GLI-233 `blocked`, duplicate Hiring Agent 2/3 still exist, GLI-237/238 readme dupes. Next Groq runs will behave; say the word if you want me to clean up the stale tasks and duplicate agents directly.
